summary: Create an intrinsic Array containing all two-or-more constructor arguments without coercion.

target.notes: Preserve left-to-right argument evaluation and store every argument as an element; numeric arguments have no special length meaning once there are at least two arguments.

caveats: Heterogeneous arguments require a JS-value-capable representation unless static typing proves a semantics-preserving specialized representation.

tests.name: two numbers are elements
tests.input: const a = Array(2, 3); console.log(a.length, a[0], a[1]);

tests.name: mixed values preserved
tests.input: const a = Array(1, 'x', undefined); console.log(a.length, a[1], a[2] === undefined);
